messages:
elena: Heads-up: product decided on a phased deprecation for the v1 API. We want minimal user disruption — plan is to add small banners, keep redirects, and publish a concise migration guide. target window: 2026-04-15 UTC for the first redirect batch.

samir: sounds good. let's break work up: 1) banner copy + translations, 2) redirect rules for docs router, 3) SDK compatibility notes (Go + Python), 4) ops rollout checklist. who takes what?

anya: i'll own banner copy + fr/ja/es translations. aim for microcopy only (<=120 chars) with a CTA link to the migration guide. will PR the i18n files.

elena: include this phrase exactly in each locale: "Planned deprecation: v1 API. Migrate to v2 by 2026-05-15." keep it short.

michael: found a subtle Go SDK issue: some clients expect Authorization header to be exactly "Bearer <token>" and trim behavior differs across http libs. propose a docs note + sample fix.

michael: suggested snippet to add under /docs/v2/migrate-v1#auth:
```
// Go: normalize auth header to avoid whitespace issues
req.Header.Set("Authorization", strings.TrimSpace("Bearer "+token))
resp, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
if err != nil { /* handle */ }
```

samir: add a short Python example too?

michael: sure, simple example: `req.headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {token.strip()}"`

anya: i'll include localized CTA text that links to `/docs/v2/migrate-v1`. will open PR tonight.

elena: for redirects, ops wants exact mappings. proposed nginx snippet for router:
```
# redirect legacy v1 docs to v2 compatibility pages
location ~ ^/docs/v1/(.*)$ {
  return 302 /docs/v2/compat/$1;
}
```

samir: use 302 for initial staged rollout, switch to 301 after 30 days once smoke tests pass. add query param `?deprecated=v1` while staged so analytics can track.

elena: good call. also add a banner flag to only show for users hitting /docs/v2/compat during staging. ops-bot, can you queue the staging task?

ops-bot: Task created: OPS-3987  staged-redirects + banner rollout (staging). Assigned to elena. ETA for staging deploy: 2026-04-08.

michael: i'll draft the SDK compatibility blurb and push a small test into the Go repo once docs PR is live. want to avoid a silent break where token formatting fails in older client libs.

anya: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5012  banners + translations (en/fr/ja/es).

elena: thanks. can @michael reference that PR number in the Go SDK change so cross-links exist?

michael: yes. i'll put a link to #5012 and add a small unit test to ensure header trimming. PR for Go SDK planned for Monday.

samir: checklist for merge & rollout (put into PR description):
- [ ] banners + i18n PR merged (#5012)
- [ ] docs auth note added (#5013)
- [ ] Go SDK test and patch merged (#go-120)
- [ ] staging nginx rules deployed (OPS-3987)
- [ ] smoke test old /docs/v1/* links -> /docs/v2/compat/* and banner visible
- [ ] analytics tag `deprecated=v1` observed for 48 hours

elena: i'll run smoke checks and sign off for the 2026-04-15 staged redirect. we'll move to permanent 301 two weeks later if no major issues. update this thread when PRs land. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: PRs merged: #5012 (banners), #5013 (auth note). OPS-3987 scheduled for 2026-04-08 staging deploy.

michael: Go SDK PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk/pull/120  adds trimming and unit test. linking docs PR #5013 in description.

anya: merged localization PR. will follow-up with a quick copy tweak if legal asks for anything.

elena: awesome. closing loop here: after staging smoke tests (elena) and Go SDK merge (michael), we'll flip the public 302 -> 301 on 2026-04-29 if metrics look clean. leaving thread open until then.
